reportType: invalid fresh Slow 4G baseline attempt with valid current-E5 diagnostic runs

methodology.aggregation: Median (middle value after numeric ascending sort) of exactly three complete cold runs.
methodology.deployment: Distinct immutable deployed HTTPS URLs; local Vite preview is rejected.

profile.name: Lighthouse Slow 4G, DevTools exact transport with CPU x4

methodology.coldRun: A new Chrome user-data directory per run, browser cache/cookies cleared, cache disabled, and service workers bypassed.
methodology.skeletonMetric: PerformancePaintTiming first-contentful-paint startTime, accepted only when the nonzero visible loading skeleton state interval covers that timestamp.
methodology.readinessMetric: Trusted CDP sentinel input accepted by eager TinyMCE after an immediate current-state recheck. The precursor readyOpportunityAt is max(uiExposedAt, editorReadyMarkAt) for current builds; exact legacy before revision 869ce7 uses uiExposedAt because it has no editor-ready mark. The opportunity-to-input reaction gap is published separately and remains part of user wait through editorReadyAt.
methodology.postMetricProofs: TinyMCE Ctrl+Z restoration plus trusted CodeMirror input and Ctrl+Z restoration remain mandatory. They run after the sealed input-validation boundary; CodeMirror source-rich is required exactly once in the post-metric diagnostic partition and forbidden from the canonical partition.
methodology.timerPolicy: Polling timeouts and the network-idle observation can only fail or annotate a run. No delay, product mark, target-ready signal, aria-busy flag, selector, or arbitrary timer can make readiness pass by itself.

metricDefinitions.navigationToSkeletonPaintMs: Navigation start to FCP while the visible nonzero skeleton spans FCP.
metricDefinitions.skeletonPaintToEditorReadyMs: Skeleton FCP to trusted TinyMCE input acceptance, before rollback or CodeMirror diagnostics.
metricDefinitions.navigationToEditorReadyMs: Navigation start to trusted TinyMCE input acceptance; exact sum of the two preceding metrics.

runs.label: before

profile.name: Lighthouse Slow 4G, DevTools exact transport with CPU x4

readinessProof.definition: Canonical editorReadyAt is the trusted TinyMCE input event accepted after a current passive user-accessible state. readyOpportunityAt is a precursor: max(uiExposedAt, editorReadyMarkAt) for current builds, or uiExposedAt only for exact legacy before revision 869ce7 when the product mark is absent.

probeDiagnostics.note: readyOpportunityAt is a passive precursor. editorReadyAt is the subsequent trusted TinyMCE input event; readyOpportunityToVerifiedInputMs publishes the harness dispatch and reaction interval explicitly.

postMetricDiagnostics.definition: Undo integrity for TinyMCE and trusted CodeMirror input plus Ctrl+Z restoration are mandatory health proofs performed after the canonical timestamp. Focusing CodeMirror may load source-rich and cannot move editorReadyAt.

canonicalReadinessWindow.definition: Requests initiated from navigation through canonical trusted-input acceptance. Response facts are completed from the final session inventory.

postMetricDiagnostics.definition: Requests first initiated only after the canonical event boundary while completing undo and CodeMirror diagnostics.

runs.note: Standalone timing evidence only. No HAR is emitted, and no canonical Network or size report is read or changed. Canonical readiness is trusted TinyMCE input acceptance after the current UI state passes the passive accessibility proof. Undo and CodeMirror checks remain mandatory post-metric diagnostics. Slow 4G thresholds are published observations, not blocking gates. Timeouts and transport-idle waits can only fail a run; they never establish product readiness.
